entries.title: Amos 4:1
segments: ¶Hear this word, you cows of Bashan, who [are] on the mountain of Samaria, Who oppress the poor, Who crush the needy, Who say to your husbands, "Bring [wine], let us drink!"

entries.title: Amos 4:2
segments: The Lord GOD has sworn by His holiness: "Behold, the days shall come upon you When He will take you away with fishhooks, And your posterity with fishhooks.

entries.title: Amos 4:3
segments: You will go out [through] broken [walls], Each one straight ahead of her, And you will be cast into Harmon," Says the LORD.

entries.title: Amos 4:4
segments: "Come to Bethel and transgress, At Gilgal multiply transgression; Bring your sacrifices every morning, Your tithes every three days.

entries.title: Amos 4:5
segments: Offer a sacrifice of thanksgiving with leaven, Proclaim [and] announce the freewill offerings; For this you love, [You] children of Israel!" Says the Lord GOD.

entries.title: Amos 4:6
segments: ¶"Also I gave you cleanness of teeth in all your cities. And lack of bread in all your places; Yet you have not returned to Me," Says the LORD.

entries.title: Amos 4:7
segments: "I also withheld rain from you, When [there were] still three months to the harvest. I made it rain on one city, I withheld rain from another city. One part was rained upon, And where it did not rain the part withered.

entries.title: Amos 4:8
segments: So two [or] three cities wandered to another city to drink water, But they were not satisfied; Yet you have not returned to Me," Says the LORD.

entries.title: Amos 4:9
segments: "I blasted you with blight and mildew. When your gardens increased, Your vineyards, Your fig trees, And your olive trees, The locust devoured [them]; Yet you have not returned to Me," Says the LORD.

entries.title: Amos 4:10
segments: "I sent among you a plague after the manner of Egypt; Your young men I killed with a sword, Along with your captive horses; I made the stench of your camps come up into your nostrils; Yet you have not returned to Me," Says the LORD.

entries.title: Amos 4:11
segments: "I overthrew [some] of you, As God overthrew Sodom and Gomorrah, And you were like a firebrand plucked from the burning; Yet you have not returned to Me," Says the LORD.

entries.title: Amos 4:12
segments: "Therefore thus will I do to you, O Israel; Because I will do this to you, Prepare to meet your God, O Israel!"

entries.title: Amos 4:13
segments: For behold, He who forms mountains, And creates the wind, Who declares to man what his thought [is], And makes the morning darkness, Who treads the high places of the earth-The LORD God of hosts [is] His name.
